:= by
  have h_char_conj : ∀ t : E*, ProbabilityTheory.charFunction (-X) P t = conj (ProbabilityTheory.charFunction X P t) := by
    intro t
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.charFunction_def, MeasureTheory.integral_neg]
    congr'
    ext f
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_conj]
    congr'
  let ϕ_X := ProbabilityTheory.charFunction X P
  let ϕ_negX := ProbabilityTheory.charFunction (-X) P
  have h_char_eq : ∀ t : E*, ϕ_negX t = conj (ϕ_X t) := h_char_conj
  have h_gauss_negX : ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw (-X) P := by
    apply ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw.congr
    erw [h_char_eq]
    exact hX
  exact h_gauss_negX
